client_pair: Web/macOS screen publisher → Android Flutter receiver
finding: A screen-share audio publication without LiveKit's explicit screenShareAudio source was not recognized by Flutter. The viewer therefore reported no audio track and did not expose stream mute/volume controls, although audio was audible.

change.detail: Prefer explicit screen-share audio. For older publishers, infer it only when there is exactly one unknown-source audio publication alongside an active screen-share video; do not guess when ambiguous or when no screen video exists. Apply this classification consistently to viewer subscription, late publications, diagnostics, mute and per-stream gain.
change.controls: Added a 0–200% gain slider to the pinned stream mini-player; existing mute control now targets the classified screen audio track.

cases: explicit screen audio source is preferred
a single unknown audio publication beside a screen is recognized
multiple unknown audio publications are not guessed
unknown audio without screen video is not misclassified

flutter_analyze.detail: No issues found after removing one unused import reported in the newly integrated upstream updates controller.
